Uranus-Pluto.s1:
Uranus — Prometheus. Liberation, breakthroughs, revolution, technology, sudden awakening.

Pluto — God of the Underworld. Resurrection, collective power, transformation, the masses-as-force.
Uranus-Pluto.s2:
The most explosive mundane combination. Radical restructuring of civilizations — "building on the ruins of the old." Not reform but revolution. Technology + mass upheaval. The 1965-66 conjunction seeded the computer age, the counterculture, and the generation now in power.

Current (trine from Gemini to Aquarius): The harvest phase of the 1960s revolution. The trine = it flows freely. The Promethean fire is in Gemini (information) flowing to Pluto in Aquarius (the paradigm shift). AI, information revolution, the radical restructuring of how humanity thinks — arriving without the violence of a conjunction.
Uranus-Pluto.s3:
• The Information War — Technology/AI, the Promethean awakening of information itself
• Fringe, Disclosure & Health — Disclosure, the hidden made visible (Pluto), radical new knowledge (Uranus)
• The Monetary Reset — Crypto as Promethean disruption of Plutocratic financial power

Neptune-Pluto.s1:
Neptune — The Ocean. Collective ideals, transcendence, dissolution, the dream of an age.

Pluto — The Underworld. Civilizational transformation, primal power, death/rebirth of entire paradigms.
Neptune-Pluto.s2:
The deepest, slowest cycle. Half a millennium per revolution. This isn't decades — it's the rise and fall of entire civilizations. The 1891-92 conjunction in Gemini seeded the current move toward global culture, mass communication, and the information age.

Current (long sextile): This sextile has been in effect since ~1941 and lasts until ~2035. The ENTIRE modern era — WWII, the Cold War, the digital revolution, everything in the Freedom 250 chronicle — unfolds within this single harmonious phase. It's the background hum. The opportunity to put deep civilizational ideals to work.
Neptune-Pluto.s3:
- Background to ALL arcs — this is the civilizational substrate beneath everything

- Most directly felt through Fringe, Disclosure & Health — the deep unconscious/superconscious content surfacing

Saturn — Kronos. Contraction, limits, structure, discipline, "not yet."

The shift from Earth (materialism, ~1842-2020) to Air (information, networks, ideas, ~2020-2220).

Current: The first square (crisis/test) of what was seeded in 2020. The Air-era social structures face their first real challenge.

• Border & Homeland — national identity in the Air age (Immigration, Civil Unrest)
• The Information War — Air = information-based power structures (Politics, Media Trust)

Saturn-Neptune.s1:
Saturn — Structure, limits, the establishment, authority, the old order. What endures. Kronos.

Neptune — Dissolution, ideals, collective dreams, propaganda, the oceanic. What transcends.
Saturn-Neptune.s2:
Barbault's paramount cycle. The dissolution of whatever has become negatively crystallized, and the descent of new collective images. Every 36 years, an established order dissolves and a new ideal is born. The conjunction is the seed of that ideal — raw, unformed, full of potential and delusion in equal measure.

Previous conjunctions: 1989 (Capricorn) = fall of Soviet communism. 1953 (Libra) = Cold War order. 1917 (Leo) = Russian Revolution. 1882 (Taurus) = rise of organized labor.

Current (2026 at 0° Aries): The post-1989 liberal-globalist order is the "negatively crystallized" structure being dissolved. The new ideal is forged in Aries — primal, survival-driven, sovereignty-first. The Aries Point (0°) = where personal and collective become indistinguishable.
Saturn-Neptune.s3:
• The Great Reckoning — the old institutional order dissolving (Government Fraud, Arrests & Legal, Epstein, Clintons)
• The Information War — the battle over which new collective image replaces the old one (Media Trust, Politics)
• Border & Homeland — the sovereignty-first ideal in Aries (Immigration, Civil Unrest)
